why_this_data.value: Higher resolution needed to resolve filaments missed by Cycle 1 data

alternatives_considered_or_rejected.value: Filamentary cloud collision model of Paper I deemed inappropriate; Rayleigh-Taylor instability excluded for pillars

evidence.quote: We thus exclude the Rayleigh-Taylor instability as a candidate mechanism to form the CO pillars in the Papillon Nebula.
